meta.description: Original MCQs for the German Klasse-B driving theory module, covering Vorfahrt und Kreuzungen, Verkehrszeichen, Gefahrenlehre, Umwelt und Technik, Allgemeines Verhalten im Strassenverkehr, Autobahn und Ueberholen, and Parken und Halten. Content is independently phrased from public StVO/StVZO rules and standardised sign shapes, NOT copied from the licensed amtlicher Fragenkatalog. Locales: de (canonical), en (reviewed translation). Extended (DN-34) with Ladungssicherung und Mitfahrende, Verhalten bei Unfaellen und Erste Hilfe, and Alkohol/Drogen und Fahrtuechtigkeit topics, plus deeper coverage of the original 6 non-sign topics. Locales expanded (DN-35) to include Turkish, French, Russian, Spanish, and Italian; all 500 questions now ship in all 12 locales.
meta.point_system: 2-5 points per question, matching real-exam weighting
meta.pass_rule_note: Real exam Klasse B: max 10 error points overall; automatic fail on 2+ wrong high_stakes (safety-critical) questions - spans multiple topics, not just Vorfahrt
meta.legal_review_status: NOT legally reviewed - verify citations and sign numbers before production/commercial use
meta.license_note: Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike: free to use, adapt, and redistribute for non-commercial exam-prep purposes, with credit and under the same license. We don't care about owning the data, only about helping people pass -- so commercial reuse needs a separate arrangement, but non-commercial prep tools/forks are welcome.
